- Full Stack Developer, DGN Infosolution (New Delhi), May – Dec 2025: delivered 5 client websites end to end on the MERN stack; built and deployed a production diagnostic-service management platform; promoted to full-time.
- Backend Developer, Sharelog (Remote), Oct – Dec 2024: production Node.js/Express REST APIs; AWS EC2, S3 and CloudFront deployments; JWT, OAuth and rate limiting.
